activity.notes: Ahmet Zogu was elected President of the Albanian Republic on 31 January 1925. On 1 September 1928 Albania was proclaimed a monarchy and he became King Zog I. ATLAS therefore records the republican presidency separately from his existing 1928-1939 royal reign.

sources.title: The History Of The Institution — President of the Republic of Albania
sources.citation_text: The Albanian Presidency states that Ahmet Zogu was elected President of the Republic on 31 January 1925 and became King when Albania was proclaimed a monarchy on 1 September 1928.
